title: Holy Cliff Yields a Nine Secret
summary: At the Holy Cliff, where flight is sealed by Wu Shi's formation and a Perfect Holy Body once fell, the group finds an incomplete True Sun Scripture and runs from a three-legged Golden Crow. Following an old scroll's map, they find the coffin of the Heavenly Court's lord, an ancient assassin Saint with a broken neck and an imperial spear, who died trying to use a fragment to activate the Xing Secret. Its inscription appears, and Hei Huang shocks everyone by grasping it first and running on two legs. The Perfect Holy Body's corpse then stirs, and a primordial wisp of the Undying Daoist reveals that he engineered their easy access and offers two more secrets if they carry him out. When they refuse, he attacks with his World of Freedom. Ye Fan takes control of the Perfect Holy Body's corpse and hits back with the Heavenly Court lord's imperial spear, destroying the killing intent, but Wu Shi's Investiture of the Gods list descends and seals the Undying Daoist again.
